title: Vocabulary
subtitle: Learn decks part by part and review cards just before you forget them.

first.title: Pick your first deck
first.desc: Start with a basic deck such as Oxford A1 or 1000 common words. Each part is one topic and takes a few minutes.

empty.title: No decks yet
empty.desc: Decks will show up here once they are added to the system.

tips.title: How to study this deck
tips.one: Each part is one topic. Study it by guessing the word, flipping cards, taking a quiz or listening and repeating.
tips.two: Cards come back just before you forget them. The better you remember, the longer the interval.
tips.three: After a part, try a different study mode to check yourself.

images.title: Add images in bulk
images.rules: Name each image after the card's word, e.g. sustain.jpg for "sustain"; use _ or - for spaces (phrasal_verb.png). Case doesn't matter. JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB each. A matching image replaces the card's current image.
